title: Original Sketches
description: ORIGINAL SKETCHES for Han Solo in STAR WARS showed him in a tailored military outfit that looked more like a general than a rapscallion. But George Lucas quickly made it clear that his heroes and villains wouldn't be clad in the kind of Spandex-tight, "futuristic" duds that were the hallmark of so many 1950's science fiction epics. Han, shown here in Nilo Rodis-Jamero sketches from RETURN OF THE JEDI, kept the same basic look throughout the trilogy.
